body.name: Omega1
body.def: \(\Omega_{n,1s}(\rho)=\{(H'_{n,s},z'_{n1s}):H'_{n,s}\subseteq\{1,\ldots,N_{n1s}\},\ |H'_{n,s}|=\lfloor\rho N_{n1s}\rfloor,\ z'_{n1s}\in\{0,1\}^{N_{n1s}},\ \sum_i z'_{n1si}=m_{n1s}\}\). Under the pre-cell candidate law, each element has mass \(\{\binom{N_{n1s}}{\lfloor\rho N_{n1s}\rfloor}\binom{N_{n1s}}{m_{n1s}}\}^{-1}\), independently across \(s\in S\).
